description: This PHP source file defines the AssignClaimRequestController class within the OrangeHRM system. The class manages the assignment of claim requests, including pre-render setup of Vue components with claim and employee data, and access control logic to determine if a user can access the functionality.

classes.name: AssignClaimRequestController
classes.description: Controller responsible for handling claim assignment view and verifying user access within the OrangeHRM Claim module.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares the Vue component with claim and employee data, redirects if user is the claim owner.

methods.name: isCapable
methods.description: Checks if the user has permission to access the claim assignment based on claim existence and user role.
